notes.title: Looking for volunteer translators
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35030854/112a2261fc03b7fd1f6f2c65145748bc80f3e128.png[/img]

Hello everybody,

We are almost at the finish line in completing The Islander: Town Architect. Planed release date is 12th of December, and even though we still need do some balancing and tweaking we would also love to translate the game to as many languages as possible and we need your help! There isn't a lot to translate - around 1300 words (this includes Steam page game description).

Languages currently covered:
[list]
[*] [b]English[/b]
[*] [b]French[/b]
[*] [b]German[/b]
[*][b]Portuguese - Brazil [/b]
[*] [b]Russian[/b]
[*] [b]Simplified Chinese[/b]
[*] [b]Spanish[/b]
[*] [b]Turkish[/b]
[/list]


Languages we want to translate to:
[list]
[*] [b]Every other language not mentioned above.[/b]
[/list]


Please leave the comment below if you would like to contribute.

Thanks a lot,
-Boxhead Bros.

notes.title: The Islander Devlog - The Catalog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35030854/77600524cb7447a15255c835538ea54c001423e6.gif[/img]

This week's "super in-depth" devlog entry is about what we call - Item Catalog.

This little piece of HUD "ingenuity" comes from the original The Islander game. Item catalog consists of all the objects (with the exception of buildings, but that's a story for a different devlog entry) you can build on your island.

All the building objects are divided into 7 groups if you are building outside: small plants, shrubs, trees, fences, lighting, pathways, decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35030854/0d10684c3388e33844fee8334b0127904900be9a.png[/img]

10 groups if you are furnishing a house: seats, beds, cabinets, tables, lamps. rugs, decorations, flooring, wallpapers and windows. We'll talk more on the furnishing in the upcoming devlog posts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35030854/caf9097500fea241a66f9c4e5d6110e62cdc87e8.png[/img]

That's it for today. See you next week.

- Boxhead Bros.
